description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw configuration file handling logic, including testing environment variable overrides, URL parsing, config modification, and auditing behavior.

methods.name: makeConfigOverridePath
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary path for OpenClaw configuration override.

methods.name: config path respects env override
methods.description: Tests that the configuration path respects environment variable override.

methods.name: remote gateway port parses and matches host
methods.description: Tests parsing and matching of remote gateway port from URL.

methods.name: set remote gateway url preserves scheme
methods.description: Ensures that setting a new remote gateway URL preserves the URL scheme.

methods.name: clear remote gateway url removes only url field
methods.description: Verifies that clearing the remote gateway URL only removes the URL, leaving other fields intact.

methods.name: state dir override sets config path
methods.description: Checks that overriding the state directory updates the config file path accordingly.

methods.name: save dict appends config audit log
methods.description: Tests that saving configuration appends an audit log entry with the expected properties.

methods.name: load dict audits suspicious out-of-band clobbers
methods.description: Verifies that load operation detects suspicious config clobbering and records audit events accordingly.
